The SyncSnitch scanner identified multiple breaking changes in the Orders API v2 update affecting the billing-service.
The billing-service will suffer loud failures in POST /invoices/{order_id} due to model field removals and GET /reports/revenue due to the database column drop.
Logic failures will occur in the NOT_PAYABLE set, which will cause silent data issues as AWAITING_PAYMENT is not correctly identified as non-payable.
Required fixes include updating Pydantic models, SQL queries, and status handling constants to accommodate the new structured fields and status names.
Full impact details and remediation mappings have been saved to run/impact.json.
